text: I need you to tell me where you are and who you are with every minute, otherwise I cannot trust you.
You cannot wear that to the party. People will think things and I do not like it.
If you go out with your friends, I will ignore you for a week.
I checked your messages while you were asleep because I had a feeling.
You do not need to see your family this weekend. I need you here instead.
Give me your passwords or it means you are hiding something.
I am not angry. I am just asking why you did not answer after four minutes.
We agreed you would tell me before making plans. You did not, and that hurt. Next time I need a heads up.
I was out of line when I snapped. I am sorry, and I will step away next time I feel heated.
You can be upset with me. Tell me what you need and I will listen.
I hear that you need tonight to yourself. Of course, take the space you need.
You are being dramatic and too sensitive. Stop overreacting.
Nobody else would put up with you. You should be grateful.
I do not care what you want. This is how it is going to be.
Fine, do whatever you want. I will just remember this.
If you really loved me, you would cancel your trip.
I told you I was not okay with sharing that photo, and you posted it anyway.
You said I could say no, but then you kept asking until I agreed.
I need some time alone after work. Please do not take it personally.
Thanks for telling me. I was wrong to assume, and I will check next time.
I feel jealous when you mention them, and I am working on it instead of making rules.
I am sorry I raised my voice. It was not okay, and I will take a break before we continue.
Why are you so cold lately? After everything I have done for you.
You owe me for all the times I let things slide.
Do that and I will tell everyone what you told me in confidence.
Stop crying. You are making this about you again.
Your opinion does not matter here. I have already decided.
I do not need your permission to go. I am telling you so you know.
I want us to talk, but I respect that you need until tomorrow.
Can we agree to put phones away during dinner? I would like us to be present.
You never listen. You always make everything about yourself.
I noticed we keep having the same argument. What part is mine to work on?
I get that you were stressed. It still hurt when you called me that. Can we talk?
I said no to lending money and they kept asking, bringing up my family each time.
They read my diary and then laughed about what they found.
They told me to delete my friends and only hang out with them.
They said they would hurt themselves if I left, so I stayed.
Every time I set a limit, they call me selfish until I drop it.
They apologised and then did the same thing the next day, again.
I was wrong. I cancelled our plan without telling you and I can see why that was hurtful.
Let us pause. I want to understand your side before we decide what happens next.
You can disagree with me. I will not punish you for having a different view.
I need you to prove you are loyal by blocking that guy.
I am watching your location because I worry. That is not controlling, it is love.
They show up uninvited even after I say I need space.
They call me names when I disagree, then say it was a joke.
They say I am just joking after every insult, then act offended when I am hurt.
They keep score of every favour and use it to get their way.
They threatened to expose my secrets if I did not do what they wanted.
I set a boundary about texting after midnight and they respected it straight away.
Thanks for saying no clearly. I will respect it.
I felt ignored when you did not reply, but I know you were driving. I will wait until you are free.
I snapped earlier. That was not fair to you. I am going to take ten minutes and come back calmer.
Why do you always have to be so difficult? Everyone else gets it.
You are useless and you never get anything right.
I do not want you going out dressed like that. It embarrasses me.
If you loved me you would not need friends who make you laugh like that.
They demanded my passwords for trust and checked them without asking.
They told me not to tell anyone about our arguments because it is private.
I told them I needed a night alone and they showed up at my door anyway.
I appreciate you telling me. I will think about it and get back to you.
I made a mistake and I want to own it instead of defending it.
I get why that upset you. I would not want that either.
They called me pathetic in front of friends and said I was too sensitive to take a joke.
They said if I did not apologise they would stop talking to me for a month.
They keep asking for photos after I said no twice.
I need you to answer every message straight away or I will assume the worst.
I feel uneasy when plans change, so I check in. Tell me if that is too much.
I should not have spoken over you. Your point matters. Please continue.
They use my insecurities as examples when they argue.
They said they would pay for my phone if I stopped seeing my friends, then took it back.
You can have your own plans. I trust you, and we can catch up after.
I was scared you were leaving, and I know that is mine to manage, not yours to fix.
They call me every ten minutes when I am out and demand a photo of the room.
They said do this or I will tell your family everything when I hesitated.
I need space tonight. I will text you tomorrow and I mean that kindly.
I said something cruel, I own it, and I am going to change how I speak when I am angry.
You always do this. You are impossible. I regret even trying.
They went through my bank statements and questioned every purchase.
I want to understand why that upset you. Can you tell me what you needed in that moment?
They said no one else would love me, so I should stop complaining.
I told them I was not comfortable and they said I was overthinking it, then did it anyway.
I let my friend borrow my notes after I said yes. That is different from being pressured.
I said I would call at eight, called at eight, and told them when I was running late.
